programs.name: Post Graduate Diploma in Management - Entrepreneurship (PGDM-E)
programs.feeNote: Non-residential: Year 1 Rs 7,25,000 + Year 2 Rs 6,70,000 = Rs 13,95,000 (first instalment includes Rs 20,000 caution deposit). Residential (double sharing): 8,55,000 + 7,70,000 = Rs 16,25,000 (includes hostel security deposit).
programs.intakeNote: 120 seats approved per EDII PGDM-E programme page.
programs.placementNote: EDII publishes no average/median placement figures on its PGDM-E page (programme is entrepreneurship-focused; placement assistance for those opting for jobs).

selectionProcess.name: Entrepreneurial Aptitude Test (EAT)
selectionProcess.detail: Online/offline; candidates need a valid CAT/MAT/XAT/ATMA/CMAT/GMAT/CUET score and a bachelor's degree with 50% (45% reserved).

selectionProcess.name: Holistic evaluation
selectionProcess.detail: Academics, entrance score, EAT and PI; weights not published.

keyDates.notes: No 2027 application dates published on the PGDM-E page as of 2026-11-12.

nirf.note: Not in NIRF 2025 Management ranks 1-100; 101-125 band not checked

sources.title: EDII - PGDM Entrepreneurship programme page (2027-29)
